title: Samsung takes the crown back from Apple as a new report claims the new Galaxy S9 display is better than the iPhone X (SSNLF, AAPL)
text: Samsung takes the crown back from Apple as a new report claims the new Galaxy S9 display is better than the iPhone X (SSNLF, AAPL) By Edoardo Maggio Mar 1, 2018, 9:11 am 17 pts Samsung launched the Galaxy S9 and Galaxy S9+ flagship smartphones at an event on Sunday, right before Barcelona's Mobile World Congress kicked off this week.
